arxiv-1501-07874.title: Stark Field Modulated Microwave Detection of Molecular Chirality
arxiv-1501-07874.creator: Kevin K. Lehmann
arxiv-1501-07874.description: Abstract Patterson, Schnell, & Doyle, Nature 497 , 475 (2013) introduced a microwave experiment that produces a perpendicularly polarized molecular emission when chiral molecules are resonantly excited in the presence of a Stark Field that is then adiabatically switched off before observation of the emission.

arxiv-2104-11125.title: ScaleCom: Scalable Sparsified Gradient Compression for Communication-Efficient Distributed Training
arxiv-2104-11125.creator: Chia-Yu Chen, Jiamin Ni, Songtao Lu, Xiaodong Cui, Pin-Yu Chen, * Xiao Sun, Naigang Wang, Swagath Venkataramani, * Vijayalakshmi Srinivasan, Wei Zhang, Kailash Gopalakrishnan IBM T. J. Watson Research CenterYorktown Heights, NY 10598, USA
arxiv-2104-11125.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chia-Yu Chen, Jiamin Ni, Songtao Lu, Xiaodong Cui, Pin-Yu Chen, * Xiao Sun, Naigang Wang, Swagath Venkataramani, * Vijayalakshmi Srinivasan, Wei Zhang, Kailash Gopalakrishnan IBM T. J. Watson Research CenterYorktown Heights, NY 10598, USA. Large-scale distributed training of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) on state-of-the-art platforms is expected to be severely communication constrained. To overcome this limitation, numerous gradient compression techniques have been proposed and have demonstrated high compression ratios.

arxiv-2206-08377.title: Supernova Precursor Emission and the Origin of Pre-Explosion Stellar Mass-Loss
arxiv-2206-08377.creator: Tatsuya Matsumoto, Brian D. Metzger
arxiv-2206-08377.description: Abstract A growing number of core collapse supernovae (SNe) which show evidence for interaction with dense circumstellar material (CSM) are accompanied by “precursor” optical emission rising weeks to months prior to the explosion. The precursor luminosities greatly exceed the Eddington limit of the progenitor star, implying they are accompanied by substantial mass-loss.

arxiv-2210-10940.title: AIROPA II: Modeling Instrumental Aberrations for Off-Axis Point Spread Functions in Adaptive Optics
arxiv-2210-10940.creator: Anna Ciurlo, Paolo Turri, Gunther Witzel, Jessica R. Lu, Tuan Do, Breann N. Sitarski, Michael P. Fitzgerald, Andrea M. Ghez, Carlos Alvarez, Sean K. Terry, Greg Doppmann, James E. Lyke, Sam Ragland, Randall Campbell, Keith Matthews
arxiv-2210-10940.description: Abstract Images obtained with single-conjugate adaptive optics (AO) show spatial variation of the point spread function (PSF) due to both atmospheric anisoplanatism and instrumental aberrations. The poor knowledge of the PSF across the field of view strongly impacts the ability to take full advantage of AO capabilities.

arxiv-2302-06767.title: Coalitional Game Theory in Power Systems: Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
arxiv-2302-06767.creator: Mukesh Gautam, Graduate Student Member, IEEE, Mohammed Benidris, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2302-06767.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mukesh Gautam, Graduate Student Member, IEEE, Mohammed Benidris, Senior Member, IEEE. Game theory-based approaches have recently gained traction in a wide range of applications, importantly in power and energy systems. With the onset of cooperation as a new perspective for solving power system problems, as well as the nature of power system problems, it is now necessary to seek appropriate game theory-based tools that permit the investigation and analysis of the behavior and relationships of various players in power system problems.

arxiv-2305-07002.creator: Xichen Liang, Kseniia M. Karnaukh, Lei Zhao, Serena Seshadri, Austin J. DuBose, Sophia J. Bailey, Qixuan Cao, Marielle Cooper, Hao Xu, Michael Haggmark, Matthew E. Helgeson, Michael Gordon, Paolo Luzzatto-Fegiz, Javier Read de Alaniz, Yangying Zhu
arxiv-2305-07002.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xichen Liang, Kseniia M. Karnaukh, Lei Zhao, Serena Seshadri, Austin J. DuBose, Sophia J. Bailey, Qixuan Cao, Marielle Cooper, Hao Xu, Michael Haggmark, Matthew E. Helgeson, Michael Gordon, Paolo Luzzatto-Fegiz, Javier Read de Alaniz, Yangying Zhu. Fast and programmable transport of liquid droplets on a solid substrate is desirable in microfluidic, thermal, biomedical, and energy devices.

arxiv-2503-23138.title: EncGPT: A Multi-Agent Workflow for Dynamic Encryption Algorithms
arxiv-2503-23138.creator: Donghe Li, Zuchen Li, Ye Yang, Li Sun, Dou An, Qingyu Yang
arxiv-2503-23138.description: Abstract Communication encryption has always been a critical infrastructure in computer technology. Existing encryption algorithms often struggle to balance cost and security—high security typically comes with high costs and low efficiency. Additionally, single encryption algorithms always carry security risks, and the design of dynamic algorithms lacks a feasible workflow.

pmc-11328498.title: Clinical and preclinical approach in AGA treatment: a review of current and new therapies in the regenerative field
pmc-11328498.creator: Lorena Pozo-Pérez, Pilar Tornero-Esteban, Eduardo López-Bran
pmc-11328498.description: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is the most prevalent type of hair loss. Its morbility is mainly psychological although an increased incidence in melanoma has also been observed in affected subjects. Current drug based therapies and physical treatments are either unsuccessful in the long term or have relevant side effects that limit their application.

pmc-11437972.title: Cutting efficiency of different dental diamond rotary instruments for sectioning monolithic zirconia and lithium disilicate crowns
pmc-11437972.creator: Sary Borzangy, Rayan Hassan Bahabri, Abdulrahman Ahmad Alsani, Ahmed Yaseen Alqutaibi, Mohammed Ahmed Alghauli, Mohammed H. AbdElaziz
pmc-11437972.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe aim of this study was to determine the cutting efficiency of different diamond rotary instrument types for sectioning monolithic zirconia and lithium disilicate anatomical crowns.Materials and methodsThe study used 30 diamond rotary instruments divided into three groups: Zirconia cutting diamond bur (White Z), super coarse grit diamond bur (KBlack), and medium coarse grit diamond bur (KBlue); Two subgroups were assigned based on the crown materials including monolithic zirconia (5YSZ) and lithium disilicate (e.max) ceramics.

pmc-11460028.title: Evolving trends, regional differences, determinants, and disease sources of provincial-level health inequalities in china 1990–2019: a temporal convergence and novel triple decomposition analysis
pmc-11460028.creator: Qingbo Wang, Jiawei Zhang, Zhihu Xu, Peng Yin, Maigeng Zhou, Li Yang, Ming Wu
pmc-11460028.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPromoting health equity has been a worldwide goal, but serious challenges remain globally and within China. Multiple decomposition of the sources and determinants of health inequalities has significant implications for narrowing health inequalities and improve health equity.MethodsLife expectancy (LE), healthy life expectancy (HALE), age-standardized mortality rate (ASMR), and age-standardized disability-adjusted life-year (DALY) rates in 31 provinces of mainland China were selected as health status indicators, obtained from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) database.

pmc-12619692.title: In Vitro Diagnostics for SARS‐CoV‐2 Infection Authorized in the United States and Approved in Japan
pmc-12619692.creator: Mayumi Idei, Kiyoshi Asada, Mototsugu Tanaka
pmc-12619692.description: In vitro diagnostics (IVDs) for severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS‐CoV‐2) played a critical role in the early detection and management of infection, yet regional disparities in their availability remain underexamined. We retrospectively analyzed molecular and antigen IVDs for SARS‐CoV‐2 authorized by the U.S.

pmc-12726833.title: Vascular endothelial-specific loss of TGF-beta signaling as a model for choroidal neovascularization and central nervous system vascular inflammation
pmc-12726833.creator: Yanshu Wang, Amir Rattner, Zhongming Li, Philip M Smallwood, Jeremy Nathans, Xiaorong Liu, Yanshu Wang, Amir Rattner, Zhongming Li, Philip M Smallwood, Jeremy Nathans
pmc-12726833.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In mice, postnatal endothelial cell (EC)-specific knockout of the genes coding for transforming growth factor-beta receptor (TGFBR)1 and/or TGFBR2 eliminates TGF-beta signaling in vascular ECs and leads to distinctive central nervous system (CNS) vascular phenotypes.

pmc-12781742.title: Tetrahydromagnolol targets TRIM38 to mediate PANoptosis in cancer cells and has the potential for synergistic cancer therapy
pmc-12781742.creator: Xiaoqing Gu, Lin Li, Ting Duan, Lijun Jin, Qinsong Sheng, Quan Gao, Mengting Chen, Xinbing Sui
pmc-12781742.description: BackgroundTetrahydromagnolol (THM) is a compound isolated from Magnolia officinalis with unique chemical structure and composition. However, its anticancer effect of THM and the underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear.MethodFirstly, the anticancer effects of THM on different cancer cell lines in vitro were investigated.

pmc-12984880.title: Global Predictors of Appointment Non-Adherence in Primary Care Settings: A Systematic Review
pmc-12984880.creator: Azzam Zohair Jad, Sitah Mohammed Alotaibi, Amjad Mohammed Asiri, Shouq Khalid Alobaid, Rana Ali Algahamdi, Latifa Abdullah Alaqeel, Khamael Fawaz Aljabri, Aisha Khaled Alamer, Jumanah Ibrahim Alsultan, Abdullah Almaqhawi
pmc-12984880.description: Background: Missed primary care appointments disrupt continuity, reduce care quality, and increase healthcare costs. Despite numerous studies, global patterns and predictors of appointment non-adherence remain inconsistently reported. Objective: To identify, categorize, and evaluate the consistency of predictors of appointment non-adherence in primary care across diverse populations and healthcare systems.

pmc-13224781.title: Increased Mortality in Patients with Bullous Pemphigoid: A Nationwide Population-based Cohort Study of 5,738 Patients in Sweden
pmc-13224781.creator: Zeyad ALBADRI, Henrike HÄBEL, Kristofer THORSLUND, Carina GRÖNHAGEN, Oliver SEIFERT
pmc-13224781.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Bullous pemphigoid (BP) is the most common autoimmune blistering disease and has been linked to increased mortality, although previous studies have generally relied on small populations and no data have been available specifically for the Swedish population. This study aimed to evaluate the 1- and 10-year mortality rates and all-cause mortality in Swedish patients with BP compared with the general population.
